text_summary.body: Darius had the archives searched; at Achmetha in Media a scroll recorded Cyrus's first-year decree for the house (sixty cubits high and wide, three courses of great stones and one of timber, costs from the king's house, the vessels restored). Darius ordered Tattenai and his colleagues to keep away, to fund the work from the tribute of Beyond the River, to supply daily sacrifices so the priests might pray for the king and his sons, and threatened impalement on a beam for anyone altering the decree.

setting.body: Darius I became king in 522 after killing Bardiya (Behistun) and was recognised in Babylonia from early 521. Haggai and Zechariah date their prophecies about the rebuilding to his second year (Hag 1:1; Zech 1:1).
